|game_text=Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. [[AT-AT Cannon]] may deploy aboard, and targets it hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Droid Walker]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Droid Walker]] (original, release sheet of 12 March 2010); [[Droid Walker (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Droid Walker (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Droid Walker]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010), slip 3•21: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"), page 4, slip 3•21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Droid Walker (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=56, page 56. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=56 Internet Archive]</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “3•21” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Droid Walker (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “may not be used” to “cannot be used”: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits cannot be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”<ref name="cl-1263_21-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-droidwalker-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Droid Walker]]) again, word for word: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “3•21” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Droid Walker (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 56)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Droid Walker]]) again, word for word: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1263-21-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “3•21”).
